headline.label: sold records that don't belong in the math

flags.text: Two cards, 39 sold records since May. Seven of them would bend a plain average: a $46 "PSA 9 Crystal Charizard," a $1,900 "PSA 8 Crystal Lugia," a raw card and a two-grade slab in a PSA 8 search, a double-counted auction, and one listing that sold twice.
flags.stat: Sold records on those two cards that don't belong in the math.
